command.description: Open the ESP32 pane: serial ports, online status and chip info
pane.title: ESP32
fail.busy: Port is busy (close the monitor or other serial tool and retry)
fail.no_response: The board did not answer (check the cable, or hold BOOT and press RST for download mode)
driver.howto: Device Manager → right-click the device → Update driver → Search automatically; or Windows Update → Optional updates
python.missing: Python not found. Install Python 3, or set ESP_PYTHON to a python.exe
python.deps: pyserial / esptool missing: {detail} -m pip install --user pyserial esptool
empty: No ESP serial device found. Check the cable (some only charge) and the USB port.
polling.paneOnly: Not scanning while the pane is closed
